short_description: CP PLUS 2.4 MP Illumax dual-light bullet: 20 m IR plus 20 m warm light for colour night video, built-in mic, 3.6 mm lens, IP67, 4-in-1 output, 12 V DC.
long_description:
## What it is

The CP PLUS CP-USC-TA24L2C-L is a 2.4 MP HD analogue bullet camera from the Illumax dual-light range, built on the familiar Cosmic bullet body. It is a white plastic bullet with a black front bezel, 163.4 mm long, 70 mm wide and 69.7 mm tall, weighing 0.18 kg, with a 3.6 mm fixed lens giving an 83° horizontal field of view. Beside the lens sit two infrared and two warm-white LEDs, and a microphone is built in. The housing is rated IP67, and the camera is made in India.

## What it's for

It is the camera for house gates, compound walls, shop fronts, parking areas and school or godown perimeters where the owner wants colour video after dark and sound with it, recorded on an HD analogue DVR. The single BNC output switches between CVI, TVI, AHD and CVBS, so it works with CP PLUS DVRs and with most other 4-in-1 recorders, and it can take the place of an older analogue camera on the same coaxial cable.

## Key specifications

The 2.4 MP PS CMOS sensor delivers 1920 × 1080 video at up to 30 fps, with 960H available on CVBS. Minimum illumination is 0.01 lux. At night the camera can run in IR mode (black and white to about 20 m), warm-light mode (colour to about 20 m) or a smart mode that switches between the two. The bracket pans 360°, tilts 90° and rotates 360°. Power is 12 V DC at a maximum of 2.6 W. It is rated for −40 °C to 60 °C at up to 95% humidity, which covers a west-facing wall in Vijayawada in May. The Indian safety reference for cameras of this class is IS 13252 (Part 1) / IEC 62368-1. Warranty is 24 months carry-in under the Aditya Infotech service policy; the power adapter is excluded.

## Installation notes

Mount on a wall or ceiling at about 3 m using the integral bracket, seal the cable joint against rain, and aim using the three adjustment axes. Run coaxial cable to the DVR and select the CVI, TVI or AHD mode to match the recorder; audio travels on the same cable. Use a regulated 12 V DC supply sized for 2.6 W per camera. Choose the warm-light mode where colour identification matters and the IR mode where a visible light would disturb neighbours. Keep the serial sticker intact and the invoice safe for warranty claims.

## What's in the box

One camera with integral bracket, video and power pigtail, mounting screws and wall plugs, a drilling template and a quick guide, in a single printed carton.
